description: An interface for task properties that support using a Grid to edit data or metadata.

collaboratorPrincipalIds.description: The set of principal IDs that should collaborate on the grid session. This field may be used to set the ownerPrincipalId(s) of a linked GridSession if the suggestedAuthorizationMode is SESSION_OWNER

suggestedAuthorizationMode.description: Optional. The authorization mode a client should use when creating a linked grid session for this task. If omitted, the client should follow legacy behavior: find or create a personal, unlinked grid session. When this field changes, the server will automatically clear any existing activeSessionId from the task status.
